# eon_backup_posture_control (Resource)

Creates and manages a backup posture control. Posture controls define the backup requirements resources must meet, such as minimum retention, number of copies, and cross-region or cross-account redundancy, and Eon reports resources that violate them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    eon = {
      source = "eon-io/eon"
    }
  }
}

# Example: Require 30-day daily retention and a cross-region copy for all resources
resource "eon_backup_posture_control" "baseline_retention" {
  name     = "Baseline Retention"
  severity = "HIGH"

  resource_selector = {
    resource_selection_mode = "ALL"
  }

  rules = {
    minimum_retention = [
      {
        frequency              = "DAILY"
        minimum_retention_days = 30
      }
    ]
    cross_region = true
  }
}

# Example: Require redundant copies for production databases only
resource "eon_backup_posture_control" "prod_database_copies" {
  name     = "Production Database Copies"
  severity = "MEDIUM"

  resource_selector = {
    resource_selection_mode = "CONDITIONAL"
    expression = {
      group = {
        operator = "AND"
        operands = [
          {
            environment = {
              operator     = "IN"
              environments = ["PROD"]
            }
          },
          {
            resource_type = {
              operator       = "IN"
              resource_types = ["AWS_RDS"]
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  rules = {
    min_copies    = 2
    cross_account = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for the backup posture control.
- `resource_selector` (Attributes) Selects the resources the control applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_selector))
- `rules` (Attributes) Backup requirements enforced by the control. At least one rule should be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `severity` (String) Severity reported when a resource violates the control. Possible values: `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Backup posture control identifier.

### Nested Schema for `rules`

Optional:

- `cross_account` (Boolean) Whether at least one backup copy must be stored in a different cloud account.

- `maximum_retention_days` (Number) The maximum backup retention period, in days.
